name: mccal-media-website
description: McCal Media photo gallery website with development tools

scripts.deploy:vercel: echo 'Vercel deployment removed for security. Use manual deployment.'
scripts.deploy:surge: echo 'Surge deployment removed for security. Use manual deployment.'
scripts.docker:deploy: docker build -t mccal-media-website . && docker run -d -p 8080:8080 --name mccal-website mccal-media-website
scripts.build:concert: npm run organize:folders && npm run manifest:concert
scripts.build:universal: npm run organize:folders && npm run manifest:concert && npm run manifest:universal
scripts.clean: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue dist, logs/*.log, site-workspace/temp, site-workspace/drafts"
scripts.analyze:large-files: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 1MB } | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object FullName, @{Name='SizeMB';Expression={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize"
scripts.repo:health: npm run clean && npm run ai:preflight:short && npm run analyze:large-files
scripts.analyze:duplicates: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | Group-Object -Property Length | Where-Object { $_.Count -gt 1 } | ForEach-Object { $_.Group | Select-Object FullName, @{Name='SizeMB';Expression={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,2)}} } | Sort-Object SizeMB -Descending | Format-Table -AutoSize"

author: McCal Media
